newsitem.title: USA: United Dominion sets merger exchange ratio.
newsitem.headline: United Dominion sets merger exchange ratio.

text.p: United Dominion Realty Trust Inc said Friday it will exchange 1.0833 shares for each South West Property Trust Inc share under their previously announced agreement to merge.
The company also said the companies have successful completed due diligence investigations under the terms of the merger.
The merger is subject to the approval of both companies' shareholders at special meetings, scheduled to be held simultaneously on December 10.
United Dominion said proxies for the meetings will be mailed next week to shareholders of record November 1.
The merger, pending shareholder approval, will be effective at the close of business on December 31.

Following the merger, United Dominion said, it will own more than 56,000 apartment homes in 211 communities spanning most of the Sunbelt. The company's total revenues will approximate $360 million and total market capitalization will exceed $2.2 billion.

It said three of South West's executive officers, John Schneider (Chief Executive Officer), Robert Sherman (Chief Operating Officer) and David Johnston (Chief Investment Officer), will join United Dominion as executive officers. Schneider, along with Mark Sandler, Robert Scharar and Ira Wender (currently directors of South West) will join the United Dominion board.-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
